title: kith-tslocal: socket_path stored as String not PathBuf; no path validation at construction
description: LocalApiClient::new() accepts impl Into<String> and stores socket_path as String. Every call site then does Path::new(&self.socket_path) before using it. Storing PathBuf directly would (a) validate the path at construction time rather than at each use, (b) remove the repeated Path::new() conversions at each call site, and (c) be more idiomatic for a struct whose primary purpose is to address a filesystem socket. Minor readability issue only — no correctness impact.
